paragraphs.text: Inside and outside, winning both ways. From the world’s inside, winning You — again, from Thine inside, we win this. World-Lord: Thine alone, love-sharers: for naught of theirs here is from afar. Here Thou, there BhavAnI — all-things’-rank-pregnant, first. But at truth’s station, neither Hers nor Thine, nor triple world’s, is split. The smug know not the lovely even; though try-favored, all things indeed. But mind, risen this even, kens not self-shape here. Ah! then — ah! — I am slain. Thy feet honored with full wealth, won by dwelling in Thee-made self: who needs neither food nor cloak ever — to him bowed am I. Ever in Thy-frame-dwelling hale, yet inside supremely burns this world. By Thy will, so do for me that here, Thy-worship-joy-made, I be.

Dwelling images, one after another. By own sap risen: Thy-lotus-feet-pair-worship-nectar-drink-glued-mind — in all-aims’-gatherings may I be: touch-joy alone for world-faring. In the whole field of dealings, plainly, while You throb inside, Lord: coming and going ever, may my things shine always. Ever in Thine own city — or cityless, roaming with Thee: not a wink’s crumb even be mine of defeat, forsooth, where Thee-made. In Thy-limb-oozed well-cool-nectar-floods brimmed, all round even: in Thy-worship-wealth here, Thy lovers in passing’s lake within roam. In great-chant-tree-shade-cool, in Thy high woods, in mine own self ever, Ruler: may I dwell, Thy honorer. To each thing of all breathers Thou dawnest, dawn-made, as. So, my Ruler, forth to show fare: three-eyes-trident-graced. From pride-cake-offering, by mine-love’s weight built: gladdened, when wilt Thou be my eyes’ ground everywhere? Dwelling in high-nectar-sea’s middle, in Thy-honor-rule alone sunk-mind: all folk-faring may I ply, savoring, everything indeed, aught even.

Then paradox, then entry. Thine here, be thing, be truth: to bare it, who here is vessel fit? This alone: name-shape-stir-and-the-rest-unequalled of Thine — takes. Taker art Thou, since. For calm, no joy-hunger a jot, in love-heaped frenzies. Freedom-wooing fruit even: no begging minded, before the heart-thief. Wake-or-other-state, or high even: whatever even, a jot of standing — for love-bowl-folk, all is Thou-lorded-mind’s high feast. Mind: eye-ring courses, everywhere loosened yet still — Thee winning, hard-long-knowing, Ruler: by love-hoard’s heat, how? Nor sundered was unmade aught, yet unjoy was never built. Yet pained and parted in all ways: O matchless-wonder-home, bow be to Thee. Thought-stain washed bright by splashed denial-blade-nectar-flood: doubt-foe unconquered crushed — Thy beholding be unbroken. Plain, enter me: then may I enter, ever, Ruler — Thine am I, since. With rush Thy frame itself: outright, high-neared, may I honor. In Thee no praise-might is any one’s — or is indeed, since passing fair art Thou. Ever again my begging is this: that restless I behold the Ruler.
